name: ORLEN
verdict: 49.90% owned by the Polish State Treasury. Poland has no sourced record of serious abuses, and no human-rights finding was found against ORLEN itself. Nothing found.
note: Livery sponsor of AF Corse's #83 Ferrari 499P in the 2026 FIA WEC; ORLEN is Robert Kubica's long-time sponsor (partnership announced for WEC since 2024, sport1.pl). Rating note: the 49.90% State Treasury stake (orlen-poland-ownership) is a state holding 5%+, but Poland has no sourced record of serious abuses in this dataset, so it is not a link. DuckDuckGo Lite searches on 2026-10-03 for findings against ORLEN itself surfaced only an EU antitrust judgment and an indictment of former managers over lost oil prepayments; neither counts under METHOD.md.
